topicTitle: Social Media Algorithms & Youth Mental Health

documents.title: US Surgeon General Advisory on Social Media and Youth Mental Health
documents.summary: Official public health advisory detailing the correlation between algorithmic infinite-scroll engagement feeds and adolescent psychological morbidity.
documents.evidence: Adolescents spending more than 3 hours daily on social media face double the risk of experiencing depression and anxiety symptoms. Features like infinite scroll, auto-play, and push notifications specifically trigger intermittent dopamine schedules designed to disrupt sleep patterns and developmental impulse control.
citations: Office of the U.S. Surgeon General, 'Social Media and Youth Mental Health Advisory', 2023

documents.title: Algorithmic Amplification of Outrage & Polarization
documents.summary: Mechanisms by which collaborative filtering models prioritize emotionally volatile content over factual balance to maximize ad revenues.
documents.evidence: NYU Center for Social Media & Politics demonstrated that moral-emotional words in social posts increased retweet/reshare rates by 20% per word, with negative outrage content receiving 4x more algorithmic distribution than neutral informational posts.
citations: Nature Human Behaviour, 'The Spread of Moralized Language in Online Networks', 2021
NYU Stern Center for Business and Human Rights

documents.title: Supportive Communities & Digital Agency for Marginalized Youth
documents.summary: Positive psychosocial outcomes facilitated by online affinity groups, peer mental health communities, and creative expression platforms.
documents.evidence: The Trevor Project's National Survey found that 68% of LGBTQ+ youth reported finding essential, life-saving social validation, suicide prevention resources, and identity affirmation through specialized online communities that were unavailable in their geographic hometowns.
citations: The Trevor Project National Survey on Mental Health, 2023
Pew Research Center, 'Teens, Social Media and Technology', 2023
